repos.name: bennyjo/phil
repos.description: Phil is a self-improving trader: an AI agent that trades short-term prediction markets and rewrites his own strategy after every settled bet. Paper 24/7 in the cloud; small capped real stakes via Pearl Connect.
repos.one_liner: A self-improving AI agent designed to trade short-term prediction markets with automated strategy iteration.
bullets: Built in Python for autonomous execution and strategy optimization.
Implements a feedback loop where the agent rewrites its own trading logic after every settled bet.
Designed for 24/7 cloud operation with support for small-cap real-money trading via Pear.
Represents a cutting-edge intersection of agentic AI and algorithmic quantitative trading.

repos.name: tigerless-labs/agent-memory
repos.description: Long-term memory runtime for AI agents — plain Markdown as the source of truth, local ranked retrieval, and an independent sleep-time Manage layer. Claude Code and Codex share one store. No API key.
repos.one_liner: A local-first, Markdown-based long-term memory runtime for AI agents.
bullets: Uses plain Markdown files as the source of truth for agent state and history.
Features local ranked retrieval and an independent sleep-time management layer.
Compatible with Claude Code and Codex, allowing shared memory across different agentic environments.
Privacy-focused architecture requiring no external API keys for memory management.

repos.name: tigerless-labs/cost-xray
repos.description: See what Claude Code and Codex actually send to the API — and what each part costs.
repos.one_liner: A diagnostic tool to inspect and calculate the real-time API costs of Claude Code and Codex interactions.
bullets: Provides granular visibility into the specific data packets sent to LLM providers.
Calculates precise cost metrics for individual agentic tasks and code generation sessions.
Essential infrastructure for teams scaling agentic workflows to manage and optimize LLM spend.
Helps developers debug token usage and identify inefficient prompt patterns.

repos.name: paperclipai/paperclip
repos.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
repos.one_liner: An open-source platform designed for managing and orchestrating AI agents in professional work environments.
bullets: Built with TypeScript to provide a robust interface for agent lifecycle management.
Focuses on the operational challenges of deploying multiple agents within a corporate workflow.
Provides centralized control for agent tasks, monitoring, and collaborative execution.
Addresses the growing need for infrastructure to govern agentic behavior in production.

repos.name: git-bug/git-bug
repos.description: Distributed, offline-first bug tracker embedded in git
repos.one_liner: A distributed, offline-first bug tracking system that is fully embedded within the Git ecosystem.
bullets: Written in Go, ensuring high performance and portability across development environments.
Stores bug data directly inside the Git repository, eliminating the need for external SaaS trackers.
Supports offline workflows, allowing developers to track issues without a constant network connection.
Integrates seamlessly with existing Git CLI workflows, making it ideal for infrastructure-heavy projects.
